objectives: Demonstrate accurate decoding, fluency and comprehension of taught short-oo words.
Explain how oo represents short /oo/ in these taught words.
Check accuracy by rereading the whole word or sentence.
concepts: oo represents short /oo/ in these taught words
The same vowel-team spelling can represent different sounds in different taught words.
Readers blend consonants and read the whole word rather than assuming a single pronunciation.
Fresh examples test transfer beyond memorised responses.

definitions.definition: Two letters that work together to represent a vowel sound.
Using letter-sound knowledge to read a written word.
Applying a learned skill to a new example.

workedExamples.prompt: Read “book”. Which vowel sound is taught in this word?
workedExamples.solution: The oo represents short /oo/ in book.

workedExamples.prompt: Compare “book” and “moon”. What should a reader remember?
workedExamples.solution: Both use oo, but the vowel sound differs by word; learn the taught pronunciation.

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
workedExamples.solution: A new item checks whether the learner can use the skill independently.

commonMistakes: Assuming every oo word has the same vowel sound.
